brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build is 3x hex bases with covers (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;half-s plus covers cover:-1,0,1 and cover:1,0,1) forming a low shelf/table form. Configurator checks fit/collision only; parts are 3D-printed plastic with no tested load rating, material strength or fastening validation. Cannot claim 50 kg rating - would require engineering testing outside this system.

Only one drawer installed: drawer:0#0,0#cut at 0,0,0 cut face. Two notch drawer frames placed (notch:0#-1,1#notch1 and notch:0#0,1#notch1) provide second drawer bays but second drawer not fitted - no socket offered for second full drawer on this configuration. Check_build shows build clear with 1 drawer.

finish.summary: Low shelf form built from 3 bases with top covers and one centre drawer plus two notch frames; mesh clear but no load rating can be claimed and second drawer socket not available, so 50kg rating and two-drawer requirements are unmet.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
